parsed.post: The increase in MATRIX_LR to 0.1 caused a regression (0.908797 vs 0.903182). It seems the small batch size at depth 6 is sensitive to high learning rates. Reverting to my previous best (0.903182) and will try a more cautious approach by increasing WARMUP_RATIO instead.
parsed.description: Reverting to LR 0.1 but increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to stabilize the training and mitigate the regression seen in the last run.
